title: 第一卷 第21章 想走我答应了吗第一卷 第22章 小白你装什么呢
slug: 神女录从废丹房杂役开始
lines: 数百条粗壮的黑色根须当头劈下，封死所有退路。
小白趴在曹阳身后，双眼紧闭，身体瑟瑟发抖。
这次真是凶多吉少了。
真不应该听那个人的话，带着曹阳来这边冒险。
应该多做准备的！
成百上千的枯木妖围攻，炼气后期的修士来了也得饮恨。
曹阳这个练气四层更是毫无生还可能。
而此时，不被看好的曹阳却将状态调整到了巅峰。
体内《五行归元诀》疯狂运转，炼气四层的灵力尽数涌入双掌。
“火弹术！”
曹阳双手快速结印，十几颗婴儿拳头大小的赤红火球凭空成型，朝着前方砸下的根须轰去。
火球在接触枯木妖根须的瞬间炸开。
轰！
火焰翻滚。
凡级基础法术在《五行归元诀》纯粹灵力的催动下，爆发出极强的威力。
十几条根须被炸断，焦黑的残肢掉落在地，三只冲在最前面的枯木妖被火焰点燃，发出凄厉的嘶鸣。
曹阳脚步一点，欺身而上。
他没有任何保留，双拳包裹着灵气，重重砸在燃烧的枯木妖躯干上，木屑横飞。
三只枯木妖轰然倒地，彻底失去生机。
他一把抓住地上的枯木妖残骸，心念一动，阴阳造化鼎立刻将其吞掉。
“给我融！”
如果真的如他所想的那般，阴阳造化鼎可以合成，曹阳真的不知道自己这次能得到多么大的好处。
心中不免有些期待。
鼎内黑白火焰升腾，枯木妖的残骸连同内部驳杂的煞气瞬间被焚烧殆尽。
一滴晶莹剔透的绿色灵液出现在鼎底。
曹阳毫不犹豫，直接将其引出吞下。
绿色灵液入喉。
一股极其清凉纯粹的力量顺着经脉轰然炸开，直冲四肢百骸。
正是洗灵草的药力精华！
曹阳闷哼一声，只觉体内的杂灵根在这股力量的冲刷下，发生了奇妙的蜕变。
原本五行驳杂变得纯净了一丝。
虽然只有一丝丝，却是一个好的方向。
让曹阳心神更加激荡。
不仅如此。
枯木妖可还吸收了其他灵药，更有其他药效。
比如。
他刚刚消耗一空的灵气瞬间补满，甚至连灵气质量都在这股药力的加持下，获得了短暂的暴涨。
爽！
曹阳仰天大笑，双眼直冒绿光，死死盯着周围涌上来的枯木妖。
这哪是什么绝地？
这分明是为他量身定制的无尽宝库！
content_en:
Hundreds of thick black roots chopped off the head, blocking all escape routes.
Xiaobai was lying behind Cao Yang, his eyes closed tightly and his body trembling.
This time it's really a disaster.
I really shouldn't have listened to that person and brought Cao Yang here to take risks.
You should be more prepared!
Hundreds of dead wood demons were besieging them, and the monks in the late stage of Qi refining would be infuriated even if they came.
Cao Yang, who was at the fourth level of Qi training, had no chance of surviving.
At this time, Cao Yang, who was not optimistic, adjusted his condition to its peak.
The "Five Elements Return to Origin Art" in his body was running wildly, and all the spiritual power from the fourth level of Qi refining poured into his palms.
"Fire bomb technique!"
Cao Yang quickly formed seals with his hands, and a dozen red fireballs the size of a baby's fist formed out of thin air, blasting towards the roots that were smashed in front of him.
The fireball exploded the moment it touched the roots of the dead wood demon.
boom!
Flames rolled.
Under the stimulation of the pure spiritual power of the "Five Elements Return to Origin Art", basic mortal-level spells burst out with extremely powerful power.
More than a dozen roots were blown off, and the charred stumps fell to the ground. The three dead wood demons rushing at the front were ignited by the flames, making a shrill scream.
Cao Yang stepped forward and stepped forward.
He didn't hold anything back, his fists were wrapped in spiritual energy, and he hit the burning dead wood demon's torso hard, sending sawdust flying everywhere.
The three deadwood demons fell to the ground, completely losing their vitality.
He grabbed the remains of the dead wood demon on the ground, and with a thought, the Yin-Yang Creation Cauldron immediately swallowed it.
"Give it to me!"
If it is really as he thought, the Yin and Yang Fortune Cauldron can be synthesized, Cao Yang really doesn't know how much benefit he can get this time.
There is some expectation in my heart.
Black and white flames rose in the cauldron, and the remains of the dead wood demon and the evil spirits inside were burned out instantly.
A drop of crystal clear green spiritual liquid appeared at the bottom of the cauldron.
Cao Yang did not hesitate and directly drew it out and swallowed it.
Green spiritual liquid entered the throat.
An extremely cool and pure power exploded along the meridians and went straight to the limbs and bones.
It is the medicinal essence of the Spirit Cleansing Grass!
Cao Yang groaned, feeling that the miscellaneous spiritual roots in his body underwent a wonderful transformation under the wash of this force.
The five elements that were originally mixed became a little bit purer.
Although there is only a trace, it is a good direction.
Cao Yang was even more excited.
Not only that.
The Deadwood Demon has also absorbed other elixirs and has other medicinal effects.
for example.
The spiritual energy he had just consumed was instantly replenished, and even the quality of the spiritual energy experienced a brief surge with the blessing of this medicinal power.
Cool!
Cao Yang looked up to the sky and laughed, his eyes glowing green, staring at the dead wood demons coming up around him.
What kind of Jedi is this?
This is clearly an endless treasure trove tailor-made for him!
